notes:
I matched 98 of the 113 stations to a Findlay 1879 row and left 15 null. No station needed extra_rows, because Findlay always prints a high and low pair in one row. Three of those rows are shared:
- Nash Point high and low both get p38r10.
- St Ann's Head high, low and the later single entry all get p39r2.
- Happisburgh gets p43r14; its light-vessel gets a separate row, p43r15.

The places you flagged:
- Hasbro' is p43r14 (HASBOROUGH).
- Spurn: the lighthouse pair is p44r12 and the light-vessel is p44r11.
- Start Point (Devon) is p36r13.
- Point of Ayr: Flintshire is p40r7 (AIR POINT) and the Isle of Man is p41r16.

Things to check:
1. Casquets, Hanois and Heligoland are null only because this table has no Channel Islands or Heligoland rows. All three lights existed in 1879, so look for them in Findlay's other sections.
2. Bull Point (p37r15) and Langness (p42r2) are lights that weren't working yet in 1879. Bull Point's row gives the character it would have but no position; Langness's says only 'Light proposed'. Decide whether these count as entries or should be null.
3. Tees 5 Buoy L.V. is p45r4. That row's name column is blank, probably a heading lost in transcription, so check the scan. The second 1880 'Teesmouth' entry I left null; if it turns out to be a Tees light, it is the same row.
4. I couldn't place the Dee L.V. (1884 onward): Findlay 1879 has no light-vessel of that name. The nearest are the Mersey board's N.W. Lightship (p40r9) and Bar Lightvessel (p40r10). It may be a later Trinity House vessel.
5. Bideford: Findlay's row (p37r14) is the pair of leading lights on Braunton Sands. Your modern name says Instow, so check which pair the keeper was at.
6. The other nulls are later lights (South Gare, Selker L.V., Anvil Point) and observer or fog-signal stations rather than lights (Great Cotes, Northrepps, Allonby, North Stack, Lundy Fog Gun Station).
7. Several matched rows have no position of their own (Landguard Point, Great Castle Head, Falmouth/St Anthony, Shambles, Bull Sand L.V., Bull Point, Langness). You'll need positions for these from another year or source.
8. Typos in the transcription to compare with the scan: 'EAST GOOWIN', 'Good[?]in', and Varne's year '18[?]0'.
